title: fix(service-analytics): draft preview answers $contains on a multi-value field as membership
body:
Fixes #36189
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

repo:objectstack#7 · os-alice · session_011y7As6FyXmJyGyHNKXUkV7

## 维护者速读

- 用户能看到什么变化：作者在 Studio 里预览草稿数据集或仪表盘时，按多值字段（标签、多选）筛选「包含」，预览的计数现在和发布后一致；文本字段的「包含」也改为区分大小写，和发布后一致；「不包含」在预览里不再报错，而是给出和发布后相同的结果。
- 为什么做：报表预览专题里的一个错数问题，替预览草稿数据的作者解决「发布前后数字对不上」。
- 出错会怎样：只影响草稿预览的计数，发布后的数据集不变；可以直接撤回本次合并。
- 要你做什么：无。

## What changes

The draft preview (`POST /api/v1/analytics/dataset/query?preview=draft`, Studio's preview mode) evaluated `$contains` as `String(value).toLowerCase().includes(…)` on every column. `packages/services/service-analytics/src/preview-evaluator.ts`:

- **`previewContains`** (new) is the one test behind the `$contains` pair.
  - On a column the host declares multi-valued or JSON-stored (`isJsonStoredShape`, the population the native `where` compile and the #36168 JSON-column refusal read), the test is MEMBERSHIP. Some element of the drafted array must equal one of the members `@objectstack/core`'s `jsonMembershipCandidates` names, compared by JSON text, which is what the SQLite construct compares. So `'1'` names the string `'1'` or the number `1`, and a nested array, an object or a non-array value holds no member, as on every SQL face.
  - On any other column the test is the case-EXACT substring of a stored string.
- **`$notContains` joins `PREVIEW_FIELD_OPERATORS`** as the exact complement. It was refused `INVALID_FILTER` / 400 on every column. A row with no value reaches it inside the shared lowering's NULL escape and is answered by `$null` there. The table's docblock requires a new arm to be measured against the shared conformance kits. It is measured against `FILTER_TEXT_CASES` in the new test file (below).
- **`matchesWhere` takes an optional `shapeOf`.** `lowerPreviewRowFilters` passes the declared shape it already receives, read through the member-to-column map, the same way the JSON-column refusal reads it. The call site in `analytics-service.ts` is unchanged.

**The card's open question (scalar case fold): fixed here, because the live rule is written down.** The rule is case-exact (#4706 Q2 = A). It is in `packages/spec/src/data/filter-text-conformance.ts:330-372` (the `$contains` family rows), `packages/services/service-analytics/src/text-match-sql.ts:84-87`, and `packages/drivers/driver-memory/src/memory-driver.ts:1538`. Measured before: `label $contains 'A'` answered native 1, ObjectQL 1, preview 3. The same kit rows also rule that a stored non-string never contains a substring (#14079). The preview searched `String(5)`, so the scalar arm now reads only a stored string. This takes the bounded-fix exemption: same predicate, same defect class (the preview disagreeing with the live faces on this operator), and the shape is pinned by the kit row.

**The folded item (a `{ $field }` comparand on a multi-value field): not taken. It is a different mechanism.** The preview resolves no field reference at all: it compares the row value against the reference object. So the scalar case is wrong too. Measured on the same composition: `label $eq {$field: alias}` answers native 2 and preview 0; `$ne` answers 2 and 4; `$gt` answers 0 and 2. The multi-value case (`label $eq {$field: tags}`: live 400, preview 200 count 0) is one instance of that. It is not the JSON-column resolver, so the seat split it to card #36677.

## Tests

- New `src/__tests__/preview-contains-membership-36189.test.ts`, 30 cases.
  - Three faces through `queryDataset` on the production composition (real `AnalyticsServicePlugin`, engine and SQLite `SqlDriver`, one pending seed draft). On `tags` and a `select` declared `multiple: true`, it covers a substring-only value, a case-only difference and a comma-joined value under `$contains`, `$notContains`, `$not` and `$or`. Each asserts native = ObjectQL = preview = the declared count. The scalar text control asserts the case-exact substring, equal on every face.
  - At the matcher: number, boolean, nested-array, object and non-array members, and the type-blind fallback for a field the host cannot name.
  - `FILTER_TEXT_CASES`: every kit row whose operators the preview evaluates. A pinned roster of six named rows makes sure the selection is not empty.
- Updated, because they pinned the old behaviour:
  - `preview-evaluator.test.ts`: the `'Hello World' $contains 'world'` fold now asserts `false`, with a `'World'` hit beside it.
  - `preview-unevaluable-operator.test.ts`: `$notContains` moves to the evaluated set, with a both-direction row in its matrix. The `$not` refusal arm now uses `$icontains`.
  - `dataset-json-column-refusal-36168.test.ts`: `$notContains` leaves `PREVIEW_UNEVALUATED`, so its JSON-column control row is now also asserted on the preview.
- Package run at `6fec79120`: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics typecheck` exit 0, and `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics test` gave `Test Files 225 passed (225)`, `Tests 5760 passed | 345 skipped (6105)`. VERDICT command-exit 0.

<details><summary>Before / after, three faces (counts over the 4-row fixture)</summary>

```text
filter                         native  objectql  preview(before)  preview(after)
tags  $contains 'a'               1        1          3               1
tags  $contains 'A'               1        1          3               1
tags  $contains 'a,b'             0        0          1               0
tags  $notContains 'a'            3        3      400 refused         3
$not tags $contains 'a'           3        3          1               3
picks (select multiple) same as tags on every row
label $contains 'a'               2        2          3               2
label $contains 'A'               1        1          3               1
label $notContains 'a'            2        2      400 refused         2
```
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (one shot, not kept)</summary>

On committed `1c39ffab6`, `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` planted the old folded-substring line at the head of `previewContains`. The anchor `if (isJsonStoredShape(shape)) {` went from 1 to 0 hits and the blob from `6fca41f2e294` to `9a65dfcb0abe`. The new test file then gave `Tests 24 failed | 6 passed (30)`. The six that stayed green are the unfiltered control, the kit-roster pin, the `_`-literal kit row, the whole-member `'ab'` rows and the undeclared-field fallback, none of which tells the two readings apart. Restore: the blob matches HEAD `6fca41f2e294` and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The first attempt was a no-op: the replacement text contained its own anchor, so the tool refused it (`anchor count moved 1 -> 1`) and ran nothing.
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- Overlap with sibling #36190 (branch `claude/issue-36190-analytics-single-media-json-refusal`, no PR open). `git merge-tree` is clean, but the overlap is real in meaning. That branch renames `lowerPreviewRowFilters`'s fifth parameter from `declaredShape` to `jsonColumnClass`, which this PR reads for `whereShape`. Whichever lands second adapts one line: membership is the `'multi-value-or-json'` class.
- `$icontains`, `$startsWith` and `$endsWith` stay refused on the preview, unchanged.
- Not measured: `$contains` on a declared temporal column whose drafted value is ISO text. The live faces type-gate it to FALSE (#15683). The preview's scalar arm still reads any stored string.

## Verification

Two minutes: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-analytics exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/__tests__/preview-contains-membership-36189.test.ts`. Expect `Tests 30 passed (30)`.

Read first, by risk:
1. `preview-evaluator.ts` `previewContains`: membership versus the case-exact substring, and the non-string guard.
2. `preview-evaluator.ts` `lowerPreviewRowFilters`: `whereShape` reads the member's column, as the refusal does.
3. `preview-unevaluable-operator.test.ts`: the vocabulary change.
